metadata.name: kolny_colony
metadata.description: KOLNY colony allocation, settlement and loss-containment program

accounts.name: new_authority
docs: Must be the pending authority, and must sign. That signature is the
whole point of the two-step handover: it proves the key exists and its
holder can transact before it takes over.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Permissionless crank. Pays for the transaction and holds no privilege.

accounts.name: depositor_ata
docs: Source of the base asset. Any token account of the base mint owned by
the signer is accepted; canonically this is the depositor's associated
token account.

accounts.name: brood
docs: Read only: the next epoch's pools are sized from accounting NAV.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Permissionless crank.

accounts.name: owner
docs: seed derivation and by `has_one = owner`, so it can only be the account
that filed this request; it serves as the payout destination authority.

accounts.name: operator
docs: The operator that will trade the ticket.
A ticket is drawn, not pushed: requiring the operator's signature means
nobody can force colony capital into a sub-account that is not asking
for it, and it ties the forager PDA below to the signer.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: The single asset the colony accounts in. Deposits, allocations, bonds,
slashing and cache coverage are all denominated in this mint, which is
what keeps the program free of any price oracle.

accounts.name: cache_vault
docs: Holds the insurance reserve that absorbs depositor losses.

accounts.name: forager_vault
docs: The forager's isolated sub-account. Its authority is the forager record
PDA, so the operator can never move base asset out of it by signing
directly; only this program can, and only along the paths written here.

accounts.name: incinerator_vault
docs: One-way sink for the burned share of a seized bond.
This program contains no instruction that transfers out of this account
and none may ever be added. Its authority is a PDA whose signing seeds
only ever appear on transfers into it, so the balance is economically
destroyed: unreachable by the authority, by an operator, and by the
program itself. Nothing here reduces the supply of any mint, and the
public copy must not describe it as if it did.

accounts.name: vault_base
docs: The colony's single custody account for idle base asset. Owned by the
brood PDA, so only this program can move anything out of it.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Permissionless caller. Promotion is decided entirely from committed
on-chain state, so anyone may push a qualifying scout through.

accounts.name: operator
docs: `has_one` and by the forager PDA seeds, and exists only so the record's
address can be derived.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Permissionless crank.

instructions.name: register_forager
docs: Creates the forager record only. The sub-account is opened by
`open_forager_vault` (its address derives from this record, so it cannot
exist first) and the bond is posted by `top_up_bond`. A forager starts
as a Scout with a zero bond and receives no main-pool capital until it
is promoted, so the three-step bootstrap is safe to interleave.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Either the forager's operator or the colony authority. Checked in the
handler, because `has_one` alone would close the authority path.

accounts.name: operator
docs: seeds. It does not sign here -- the authority may also retire a forager,
and the bond returns to the operator on either path.

accounts.name: operator_token_account
docs: Destination for the returned bond. Must be owned by the operator, which
holds even when the authority is the one retiring the forager.

accounts.name: forager_vault
docs: The forager's isolated sub-account. Holds bond plus principal.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Permissionless crank.

accounts.name: operator
docs: forager record and by the forager PDA seeds below; no data is read from
this account and nothing is transferred to it.

accounts.name: incinerator_vault
docs: Locked sink. This program has no instruction that moves tokens out of
it, which is the whole mechanism: what lands here is unrecoverable.

accounts.name: position
docs: The seed derivation binds this position to the signer, which is the same
guarantee `has_one = owner` gives; the stored owner is compared as well
so a position can never be operated by anyone but its holder.
The position is deliberately NOT closed when its balance reaches zero.
A `close` constraint is unconditional -- Anchor would close the account
at the end of every withdrawal, partial ones included, destroying a
still-positive share balance along with it. Closing only on a full exit
would mean a conditional close in the handler, which buys back a small
rent deposit in exchange for a re-creation charge on the next deposit
and one more failure mode. Leaving the account alive at zero shares is
cheaper for anyone who re-deposits and keeps an honest, readable record
of a zero balance.

types.name: BroodVaultState
docs: Brood Vault share accounting. Singleton, seed `[b"brood"]`.
`nav = idle_base + outstanding_principal`. Both are accounting counters that
only move through credited deposits, withdrawals and settlement, never by
reading a live token balance. That is what makes an unsolicited transfer
into a vault account unable to move the share price.

types.name: ColonyConfig
docs: Global colony configuration and epoch state. Singleton, seed `[b"colony"]`.

fields.name: pheromone_sum
docs: Normalization denominator confirmed at the end of the last settlement.

fields.name: pheromone_sum_acc
docs: Running sum during a settlement; becomes `pheromone_sum` at finalize.

fields.name: alloc_rest_sum
docs: Total pheromone of the foragers left UNCAPPED by the solved
water-filling level. Paired with `alloc_remaining_bps`, this defines
every uncapped weight as `remaining_bps * tau / rest_sum` without ever
forming a quotient, so no division rounding biases the targets.

fields.name: epoch_turnover_used
docs: Capital moved so far this epoch, against the turnover cap.

fields.name: settleable_forager_count
docs: Foragers that must be settled this epoch: every registered forager that
is not retired, whatever its lifecycle state. This is the population the
crank counts against, and it is frozen for the duration of a settlement
so `settled_count == settleable_forager_count` is a sound completion
test even when a forager is demoted mid-crank.

fields.name: active_forager_count
docs: Foragers that were Active at the last finalize. Only these are
normalized into weights; it is a strictly smaller population than
`settleable_forager_count`.

fields.name: active_count_acc
docs: Running count of Active foragers during a settlement.

fields.name: promote_min_realized_epochs
docs: Scout epochs that must have closed with a non-zero realized result.
Counts epochs, not fills; see `constants.rs` for why.

fields.name: alloc_remaining_bps
docs: Share of the pool left for uncapped foragers at the solved level:
`BPS_DENOM - capped_count * effective_w_max`.

fields.name: max_leverage_x
docs: Fixed at 1 by policy. Present so the zero-leverage rule is auditable.

types.name: ConfigPatch
docs: A partial edit to the live configuration.
`None` means "leave this parameter where it is", which is not the same as
zero. Sending a full struct of concrete values on every edit would make a
forgotten field silently reset a parameter, so the patch carries only what
the caller actually intends to move.

types.name: DepositorPosition
docs: A depositor's share balance. Seed `[b"position", depositor]`.

types.name: ForagerState
docs: One forager: an operator-run trail the colony can send capital down.
Seed `[b"forager", operator, forager_id:u64 LE]`.

fields.name: bond
docs: Posted bond. Held inside `forager_vault` but accounted separately, so
settlement can subtract it before measuring performance.

fields.name: principal
docs: Colony capital currently deployed to this forager.

fields.name: pheromone
docs: Trail strength, FP6.

fields.name: high_water
docs: Highest principal-relative equity seen, for drawdown.

fields.name: realized_epochs
docs: Epochs this forager closed with a non-zero realized result. Named for
what it actually counts: the program cannot observe individual trades,
only settled epoch outcomes, so it does not claim to be a trade count.

fields.name: scout_perf_cum_bps
docs: Cumulative risk-adjusted realized performance, for the promotion bar.

types.name: InitColonyParams
docs: Every parameter an authority may set at genesis.
What is deliberately absent is as much a part of the contract as what is
present. `max_leverage_x` is pinned to `MAX_LEVERAGE_X` by the program and
is not settable here; neither are the fixed-point scale, the pheromone floor
and ceiling, the minimum deposit, or any epoch counter. An authority tunes
the colony, it does not redefine it.

types.name: RedemptionRequest
docs: A queued redemption. Seed `[b"redeem", depositor, request_id:u64 LE]`.
The program cannot force-liquidate capital that is already deployed to a
forager, so a withdrawal larger than idle liquidity queues here instead of
promising an immediate payout it cannot honor.

types.name: RiskCacheState
docs: Insurance cache. Singleton, seed `[b"cache"]`.

fields.name: incinerator_vault
docs: Locked sink. No instruction ever withdraws from it.

types.name: TrailBoard
docs: The largest trails seen during the current settlement.
Singleton, seed `[b"trail_board"]`.
Only the largest `floor(1 / w_max)` trails can ever sit at the concentration
cap, so keeping the top `TOP_TRAILS_LEN` values is enough to solve the
water-filling level exactly at finalize, without a pass over every forager.
